body:
An Apollo entity source can yield its result and then cancel the final asynchronous stream read. Before merge ownership transfers, the Apollo execution node's cancellation catch returns without disposing its retained result.

This PR disposes that result before the existing cancellation return, matching the neighboring failure cleanup. Cancellation status, diagnostics and successful transfer paths stay unchanged.
